topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, cellular oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the historical discovery of transforming viruses and the experimental assays used to demonstrate cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressors, and mutational mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic and tumor-suppressive mutations alter cell cycle regulation and protein function.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular pathways, repair defects, and mitotic errors that cause sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the multi-step progression of cancer, the impact of inherited mutations on tumor development, and the role of genetic alterations in malignancy.
